d: Majrooh Sultanpuri was one of the greatest Urdu poets and lyricists in the history of Indian cinema. From writing the legendary song Jab Dil Hi Toot Gaya for K. L. Saigal to penning Papa Kehte Hain, Pehla Nasha, and Tere Mere Milan Ki Yeh Raina, Majrooh's extraordinary career spanned generations of Bollywood music. But behind these timeless songs was a revolutionary poet who challenged authority, stood by his political beliefs, and refused to apologise for a poem criticising Jawaharlal Nehru. In this episode of Rough Copy by Khabargaon, we explore the remarkable life and legacy of Majrooh…
